title: Supplemental regional records for previously empty information categories
policy: Records are named examples with source links, not exhaustive inventories. Category coverage is not equivalent to complete 36-region coverage. Expand only after region-specific source verification.

records.name: Deccan volcanic province

records.name: Magadha
records.description: Ancient kingdom centred in south Bihar; a major power in the rise of the Mauryan Empire.

records.name: Kosala
records.description: Ancient kingdom associated with the middle Gangetic plain and the Ayodhya region.

records.name: Satavahana polity
records.description: Deccan dynasty with important centres and inscriptions in the region of present-day Andhra Pradesh and adjoining states.

records.name: Western Chalukyas of Kalyani
records.description: Medieval Deccan dynasty with major centres and architectural remains in present-day Karnataka.

records.name: Imperial Cholas
records.description: Medieval Tamil dynasty known for temple architecture, inscriptions and maritime activity.

records.name: Ahom kingdom
records.description: Brahmaputra valley kingdom founded in the 13th century; ruled much of Assam until the 19th century.

records.name: Kingdom of Manipur
records.description: Historical Meitei kingdom with a long dynastic tradition in the Imphal valley.

records.name: Partition of Bengal (1905) and Swadeshi movement

records.name: Jallianwala Bagh massacre (1919)

records.name: Quit India Movement (1942)

records.name: Quit India movement in Assam

records.name: Rabindranath Tagore — Gitanjali
records.description: Tagore's Gitanjali is a landmark work in Bengali literature; Tagore received the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature.
